title: Software Development Engineer, Security
summary: Join Amazon's security engineering organisation to build systems that help development teams create and release secure software at global scale. You will design dependable services, solve complex engineering problems, contribute to technical architecture, and improve tools used across the business. The work combines hands-on development with operational ownership and collaboration across multiple teams.
responsibilities: Shape architecture for security learning systems
Build scalable and reliable cloud services
Lead technical design across security stakeholders
preferred_qualifications: Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
